why_now.text: OpenAMRobot's ROS 2 Jazzy platform repo (openamr-platform-sw) was created 2026-05-13 and reached 211 stars and 33 forks by 2026-11-03, with 35 issues and 65 PRs mostly from outside contributors. A hardware repo (openamr-platform-hw) and a pinned release repo (openamrobot-release, first release 2026-07-11) followed, and the platform repo's first tagged release came 2026-10-06. Evidence is for an open-source ecosystem run by Botshare LTD, with no revenue or funding data shown.
